It sounds incredibly exhausting to carry that weight of anxiety with you everywhere you go, whether you are at school, at home, or with friends. Please know that you are not alone in feeling this way, and it is completely okay to seek support to find some relief.

When anxiety feels overwhelming, practicing grounding techniques can sometimes help bring your focus back to the present. Taking slow, deep breaths or focusing on specific things you can see and hear around you can help signal to your body that you are safe. Because this anxiety is affecting so many areas of your life, reaching out to a school counselor, a doctor, or a mental health professional could be a very helpful next step. They can work with you to understand what is driving the anxiety and help you build personalized strategies to feel more at ease.
